description: This class, ModuleFileParser, parses the config.xml file inside an OpenMRS module JAR to produce a Module object. It reads various configuration elements such as module metadata, dependencies, privileges, global properties, extensions, advice points, and conditional resources. The class provides constructors for parsing from a File or InputStream, handles XML parsing with custom entity resolution, and performs validation of version and required elements.

classes.name: ModuleFileParser
classes.description: A parser class that reads the config.xml of an OpenMRS module JAR file and constructs a Module object based on its contents.

methods.name: parse(File)
methods.description: Main method to parse a module JAR file and produce a Module object.

methods.name: parse(InputStream)
methods.description: Parses an InputStream of a module file, copying into a temporary file and then parsing.

methods.name: getModuleConfigXml
methods.description: Extracts and parses the config.xml entry from the module JAR.

methods.name: createModule
methods.description: Constructs a Module object from the parsed XML Document and file.

methods.name: ensureValidModuleConfigVersion
methods.description: Validates the configVersion attribute of the XML root element.

methods.name: extractRequiredModules
methods.description: Reads the require_module elements to build a map of module dependencies.

methods.name: extractPrivileges
methods.description: Reads privilege elements to create a list of Privilege objects.

methods.name: extractGlobalProperties
methods.description: Reads globalProperty elements to create a list of GlobalProperty objects.

methods.name: extractConditionalResources
methods.description: Reads conditionalResource elements for resource dependencies based on platform version.
